newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia predicts higher 1997 imports, exports.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia predicts higher 1997 imports, exports.

text.p: Indonesia's Industry and Trade Ministry said on Thursday the country's non-oil and gas imports were expected to total between $43.8 billion and $44.2 billion in 1997, up from an estimated total of between $39.2 billion and $39.6 billion this year.
It said non-oil and gas exports were expected to total between $44.7 billion and $45.1 billion in 1997, compared with between $38.8 billion and $39.1 billion this year.
The statement said investment growth was expected to ease to 10.7-11.2 percent this year from 15.20 percent in 1995.
